column1: # SEAM English pronunciation exceptions for resource seam-en-us (table v1).
# Format: lowercase word<TAB>phones in English hint syntax, vocabulary
# seam-en-arpabet-v1. Entries take precedence over the pinned CMUdict revision.
# Every entry is an engineering selection pending native-speaker review; none
# ba: CMUdict lists the letter-name reading B IY2 EY1 first; the sung vocable
# uses CMUdict's own second variant ba(2).
# lovin, nothin: CMUdict's first readings of these apostrophe-less spellings are
# name/regional forms (L OW1 V IH0 N, N AA1 TH IH0 N). Lyrics use them as
# dropped-g forms of loving/nothing, matching CMUdict's own nothin' entry.
# woah: spelling of the interjection CMUdict lists as whoa (W OW1).
# ooo: spelling of the vocable CMUdict lists as ooh and oooh (UW1).
# cuz: spelling of the clipped form CMUdict lists as 'cause (K AH0 Z).
